title: Migration aborts on every site that never set `embed_category`
description: `execute(...)[0]['id']` indexes row 0 unconditionally. `embed_category` defaults to `''` and is only persisted when overridden, so the `INNER JOIN` returns zero rows for almost every install. `PG::Result#[]` raises `IndexError`, aborting the migration. Line 15 has the same issue. Fix: guard both queries with `if rows.cmd_tuples > 0`, defaulting to `0`.

title: Migration copies host values verbatim, migrated hosts never match new lookup
description: Migration inserts raw SQL, bypassing the `before_validation` callback that strips schemes/paths. Rows land as `http://discourse.org` but `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares against `URI(referer).host` (`discourse.org`), so no match. Values with `'` also break the interpolated INSERT. Fix: normalize in Ruby before inserting with `h.sub(/\Ahttps?:\/\//, '').sub(/\/.*\z/, '').strip` and use `quote(h)`.

title: `lower(host) = ?` never downcases the parameter
description: `URI#host` preserves case, so mixed-case hosts in Referer headers never match the lowercase query. The parameter itself is never downcased despite `lower()` in SQL. Fix: `where("lower(host) = ?", host.downcase).first`.

title: Fabricator file contents are swapped
description: `category_fabricator.rb` contains only `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains all category fabricators. Tests pass due to directory loading, but editing a category fabricator opens the wrong file. Fix: swap the two files' contents back.

title: Admin host endpoints 500 on missing params or unknown id
description: `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` with no nil guard; `POST` without `host` param raises `NoMethodError` and returns 500. `embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:16` calls `host.destroy` on `where(id: ...).first` with no presence check, so `DELETE` with stale id 500s. Fix: use `self.host = host.to_s.sub(...)` and guard lookups with presence checks.

title: `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` and `saveChanges` action are no-ops
description: `#update` re-renders `@embedding` without writing anything; `admin-embedding.js.es6:5` calls `.update({})` against it. Route reads as a working save endpoint but does nothing. Fix: drop `saveChanges`, `EmbeddingController#update`, and the `put "customize/embedding"` route until there is state to save.
